name: Something Strange
source:
Are you a human? Well in this game, you can play as one! Start your day and go about your normal, everyday life, making new friends along the way. Don't like making tough choices? Well you're in luck, because this game doesn't have any! All you have to do is sit back and enjoy this short visual novel, which may or may not contain something behind the door.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你是人类吗？在这款游戏里，你可以扮演一个人类！开始新的一天，过着平凡的日常生活，沿途结交新朋友。不喜欢艰难的选择？那你可走运了，因为这里一个也没有！你只需放松下来，享受这部短篇视觉小说。至于门后有没有藏着什么东西，那可就不一定了。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1999700/]Steam[/url]]
